chat.source: Medians from the Azure LLM inference trace, conversation (prompt 1,020, output 129 tokens): Patel et al., Splitwise, ISCA 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18677 [W] (params.md section 6). Lognormal sigma 0.8 and the clipping bounds are assumptions [G].

long32k.source: 32K uncached prompt: params.md section 8 nominal context (agentic prefixes 32K-256K, TraceLab https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30560 [W]); output 338 tokens = ShareGPT mean output (vLLM paper, https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) [M]; the design-B worked example uses the same pair.

agentic.source: Per call 875 new input and 214 output tokens (TraceLab median call, https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30560 [W]). An initial history of 32,768 tokens and 64 calls give a mean prompt of about 68K tokens, the SWE-bench Pro Codex trace mean of 68,329 (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Inferact/codex_swebenchpro_traces [S]); the call count and the 5 s think time between calls are assumptions [G].

reasoning.source: Input as chat (Azure conversation median 1,020 [W], sigma [G]); output 2,048 tokens is params.md section 8's reasoning value, an assumption [G] (no trace with reasoning output lengths was found).
